newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary July industry output up 11.7 pct mo/mo.
newsitem.headline: Hungary July industry output up 11.7 pct mo/mo.

text.p: Hungary's industrial output rose by a seasonally adjusted 11.7 percent in July from June and rose 8.3 percent from July 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Wednesday.
HUNGARY INDUSTRY OUTPUT July 1996 June 1996 July 1995

NOTE - Industrial sales in July rose 11.5 percent from July last year. Domestic sales rose 8.7 percent, while export sales increased by 18.3 percent. Out of total industrial sales exports accounted for 31 percent, up from 30 percent in July 1995.
